full_prompt_en: A square pixel-art landscape shows a small red-roof cabin on a bright grassy clearing beside a dramatic mountain valley. The cabin sits left of center beneath a broad dark green tree. Its walls are warm brown wood, with a few tiny glowing windows and a porch facing the open field. A blue dome tent rests close to the tree trunk at lower left. A narrow reddish dirt path curves from the foreground past gray rocks and leads toward the cabin before disappearing into the valley. At the far right of the clearing, two minute hikers stand together, emphasizing the enormous scale of the distant landscape. The right side is occupied by steep blue-gray mountains with scattered white snow and thin orange-lit edges. Layered blue and green ridges fade into the central distance. Above them rises a giant bank of cream-white cumulus clouds, swelling in rounded clusters across the upper right. Deep teal sky and darker blue cloud masses fill the upper left behind the tree canopy. Sunlight from the right paints the grass lime and yellow, touches the red roof, and warms selected mountain edges. Dense clusters of square pixels build leafy crowns, rock faces, and cloud contours with deliberate color steps. The scene uses a wide view, with the little cabin and figures in the lower third and monumental weather filling the upper two-thirds. Its whole composition combines inviting human scale with grand natural space, vivid color, and precise pixel texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形像素风景画呈现戏剧性山谷旁、明亮草地空地上的一间红屋顶小木屋。木屋位于中央偏左的一棵宽大深绿树下，墙面是暖棕木材，有几扇微小发亮窗和朝向空地的门廊。蓝色圆顶帐篷紧挨左下方树干。一条窄窄红褐土路从前景绕过灰石，通向木屋后消失在山谷里。空地最右边，两名极小的徒步者并立，强调远方景观的巨大尺度。右侧由陡峭蓝灰色山峰占据，散布白雪和细窄橙色受光边。层叠蓝绿山脊向中央远处淡去。其上，一大片奶白积云以圆鼓鼓的簇群在右上方膨起。深青绿天空和更暗的蓝云块填满树冠后方的左上角。右侧阳光把草地涂成青柠绿与黄色，照亮红屋顶，也温暖部分山缘。密集方形像素以有意的色阶构成树冠、岩面和云朵轮廓。画面采用宽阔视野，让小木屋与人物位于下三分之一，巨大的天气变化填满上方三分之二。整幅构图把亲近的人类尺度与宏大的自然空间、鲜明颜色和精确像素肌理结合。
style_prompt_en: The pixel-art style builds an expansive scene from visible square color clusters and carefully stepped edges. Rounded masses are modeled through layered blocks of cream, pale gray, and cool blue, while dense organic areas use speckled dark green, olive, and lime. Warm terracotta and golden highlights punctuate the cooler teal atmosphere. Distant forms lose contrast in successive blue-green layers, creating clear depth without smooth gradients. Broad silhouettes stay readable at a glance, yet fine pixel clusters provide rich surface variation in foliage, stone, and cloudlike textures. Dramatic light strikes selected edges and bright foreground patches, leaving neighboring zones in saturated cool shade. A low band of intimate details beneath a vast upper field creates strong scale contrast. The image feels handcrafted and nostalgic but visually ambitious, using controlled color ramps and crisp raster texture to convey atmospheric space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种像素画风格以可见方形色块和精心阶梯化边缘建造开阔场景。圆鼓鼓的大形通过奶油白、浅灰和冷蓝的层叠方块塑造，密集有机区域则使用点状深绿、橄榄绿和青柠绿。温暖陶土色与金色高光点缀偏冷的青绿氛围。远方形体在连续蓝绿层次中降低反差，不依靠平滑渐变也能产生清楚纵深。宽阔轮廓一眼可读，细小像素簇又为枝叶、岩石与云状肌理提供丰富表面变化。戏剧性光线击中选定边缘和明亮前景斑块，相邻区域留在饱和冷影里。亲密细节组成低处窄带，宽大的上部区域与之形成强烈尺度对照。图像有手工制作的怀旧感，却又富有视觉雄心，用受控色阶与清晰栅格肌理传达空气空间。
theme_en: A pixel-art mountain valley with a red-roof cabin beneath immense clouds
theme_zh: 巨云下红屋顶木屋与山谷的像素画
name: Pixel art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
